candidate.scope: actual layer-1 Q6 selected-down resident T16 weight with natural M512 routing
candidate.production: 64 output columns x 32 routed rows, local128, four waves x eight rows, one shared weight decode
candidate.candidate: 64 output columns x 32 routed rows, local64, two waves x sixteen rows, one shared weight decode
candidate.distinction_from_closed_row_halves: The candidate retains one LDS weight tile and one decode per workgroup; rejected quartet/direct row halves duplicated streamed weight decode.

validation.red: The expanded Q6 primitive test failed because the local64 selector did not exist.
validation.green: The local64 shared-weight body passes the uneven/empty-expert CPU-reference quality gate and is BF16-byte identical to production.

protocol.scope: nine counter-rotated burst-three HIP-event samples; pack excluded; actual resident weight and natural routing metadata

decision.action: Reject and remove the local64 primitive, wrapper selector, and test surface before runtime integration.
decision.reason: Doubling per-lane row accumulators and serial weight-cache fills costs more than the smaller workgroup saves.
